result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The test class passes, 4 of 4 tests.

**Change** (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`): the subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter and per-weekday purchase-order reports use. The rest of the query is untouched, so reps with no purchase orders still show 0 and the ordering is unchanged.

**Test** (`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`): added `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders`, which mirrors your example. I also gave the test helper an overload that takes a status. The test expects `Anna:1, Bob:1`.

Not committed.
